mapping.draft_py:
# Dragon Mage: "Flying" (compiled keyword) +
# "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, each player discards their hand,
#  then draws seven cards."
# Event: the Jeskai Elder shape (B2b, B-57 to-a-player filter).
# Discard: Chandra, Flame's Catalyst's "Discard your hand" MOVE_ZONE with every YOU made ANY
# (Liliana, Waker of the Dead's "Each player discards a card" convention: controller ANY).
# Draw: DRAW takes one player (role_player, B-108), so "each player draws" is EachPlayer(ANY).
wheel = TriggeredAbility(
    event=DamageDealtEvent(
        amount=QUnbounded(),
        filter=FNot(inner=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_PERMANENT)),
        source=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
        combat=True,
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=Seq(steps=(
        A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
            'cards': Selector(
                count=QUnbounded(),
                mode=SelectorMode.ALL,
                filter=FAnd(children=()),
                zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.HAND, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
            ),
            'controller': ControllerRef.ANY,
            'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.GRAVEYARD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
            'from': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.HAND, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
        }),
        EachPlayer(
            ref=ControllerRef.ANY,
            effect=A(Verb.DRAW, {'amount': QConst(value=7), 'controller': ControllerRef.YOU}),
        ),
    )),
)
abilities = [wheel, *compiled]

clauses.clause: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, each player discards their hand, then draws seven cards.
clauses.ir: abilities[0] (event: abilities[0].event; discard: abilities[0].effect.steps[0]; draw: abilities[0].effect.steps[1])

mapping.notes: Event = Jeskai Elder shape (B-57 to-a-player filter). Discard = Chandra Flame's Catalyst -8 discard-hand MOVE_ZONE with YOU->ANY (Liliana Waker each-player-discards convention), all hands at once; then EachPlayer(ANY, DRAW 7) because DRAW takes one player (role_player, B-108). Packs: unblocked -> both hands 7, discards in owners' graveyards; blocked by a reach creature -> no trigger.
